title: Harbor and Lantern
premise: In the fog-bound port city of Vellamare, apprentice clockmaker Xanthe Zhou is summoned to repair the observatory's failing master clock, only to find a child abandoned at its door with orders to forget her face. The girl, Isra, carries a hidden ledger implicating the Harbor Guild's magnate, Corvus Aldane, in smuggling and drowned debts — and Xanthe's own master was one of his silenced partners. As Aldane's men close in and the workshop is marked for burning, Xanthe must choose between finishing the clock that will time the Guild's fraudulent tide-auctions or exposing them. In the end, Xanthe completes the repair but rewires it to strike a forbidden hour, halting the auction long enough for the harbor's found family of dockworkers, lamplighters, and outcasts to testify; Aldane falls, the child finds a home, and Xanthe learns that belonging is something built, not granted.
about_author: Wren Ashgrove is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing port ledgers and lighthouse logs along the northern coast. Their fiction draws on the rhythms of tide tables and the quiet heroism of tradespeople who keep cities running.

chapters.title: The Summons
chapters.summary: Xanthe Zhou, measuring life in portable things, receives the Guild's summons to repair the observatory master clock. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: cautious hope — this commission could save their master's struggling workshop.

chapters.title: A Child at the Door
chapters.summary: Arriving at the observatory at dusk, Xanthe finds a silent girl left on the steps with a note: forget her face. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: unease hardening into reluctant responsibility.

chapters.title: Gears and Ghosts
chapters.summary: Inside, Xanthe diagnoses the clock's sabotage while Isra watches from shadows. The mechanism has been deliberately slowed. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: dawning suspicion that the breakdown is no accident.

chapters.title: The Lamplighter's Oath
chapters.summary: Old friend Sefa the lamplighter takes Isra in for the night and shares rumors of vanished Guild partners. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: warmth of the harbor's informal family, shadowed by fear.

chapters.title: What the Ledger Weighs
chapters.summary: Xanthe discovers Isra sewed a coded ledger into her coat — names, tides, payments. One name is Xanthe's missing master. POV: alternating Xanthe/Isra. Emotional beat: grief colliding with resolve.

chapters.title: Corvus Aldane
chapters.summary: The magnate visits the observatory, charming and cold, inspecting the repair 'personally.' He mentions Xanthe's master by name. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: terror masked as courtesy.

chapters.title: Tide Auctions
chapters.summary: Xanthe learns the repaired clock will time auctions selling harbor berths on falsified tide data, drowning small boatmen in debt. POV: dockworker Bram. Emotional beat: anger of the dispossessed.

chapters.title: Isra Speaks
chapters.summary: Isra finally talks: she is Aldane's clerk's daughter, smuggled out with proof before her father 'fell from the seawall.' POV: Isra. Emotional beat: trust tentatively extended to strangers.

chapters.title: The Workshop Still Stands
chapters.summary: Xanthe returns home to find the shop watched by Guild men; their master's tools are being inventoried for seizure. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: protective fury.

chapters.title: An Hour That Doesn't Exist
chapters.summary: Studying the clock, Xanthe realizes the escapement could be rewired to strike an uncharted thirteenth hour — a halt nothing in the harbor can ignore. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: dangerous hope.

chapters.title: Sefa's Debt
chapters.summary: Sefa is blackmailed into reporting Xanthe's movements; she confesses to the group rather than betray them. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: shame transformed into solidarity.

chapters.title: The Clerk's Widow
chapters.summary: They find Isra's mother alive in hiding; she confirms the ledger but begs them to stop before more children are orphaned. POV: Isra. Emotional beat: the cost of truth weighed against safety.

chapters.title: Fire Watch
chapters.summary: Aldane orders the workshop burned 'for insurance'; Bram's dockworkers form an all-night watch. POV: Bram. Emotional beat: ordinary people choosing courage.

chapters.title: Sabotage Reversed
chapters.summary: Xanthe works through the night restoring the clock's true rate while secretly building the false-hour mechanism. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: craftsman's trance, love expressed through precision.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Observatory
chapters.summary: A bribed assistant reveals the plan; Aldane seizes Isra and the ledger, giving Xanthe until the next full tide to finish and stay silent. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: despair's floor.

chapters.title: The Long Pendulum
chapters.summary: Imprisoned in the clock room to complete the work under guard, Xanthe hides messages inside the striking train for anyone who listens. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: quiet defiance.

chapters.title: Every Lamp in Vellamare
chapters.summary: Sefa reads the clock's hidden message in its chime pattern and relays it lamp by lamp across the city; the harbor mobilizes. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: the found family becoming a network.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Hour
chapters.summary: At the auction's opening, the master clock strikes an hour that does not exist. Bells answer from every quarter; the auction freezes in legal chaos. POV: multiple. Emotional beat: triumphant rupture.

chapters.title: Testimony at the Seawall
chapters.summary: In the confusion, dockworkers, the widow, and Isra herself present the ledger to the harbormaster's tribunal as crowds hold back Aldane's men. POV: Isra. Emotional beat: a child reclaiming her father's voice.

chapters.title: The Fall of Corvus Aldane
chapters.summary: Confronted with the ledger and his own falsified tide tables, Aldane's allies abandon him; he is taken by the magistrates as the crowd watches in silence. POV: Bram. Emotional beat: justice without spectacle.

chapters.title: Setting the Rate
chapters.summary: Xanthe removes the false-hour mechanism, leaving the clock honest, and inscribes their master's name inside the case. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: grief given permanence and peace.

chapters.title: Harbor and Lantern
chapters.summary: Isra is adopted by Sefa and Bram's circle; the reopened workshop takes apprentices from the docks. Xanthe stays, carrying nothing they cannot put down. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: belonging, finally built and kept.
